title: Healthcare Insights: As Millions Lose Health Coverage, Those Who Provide Care Suffer - NewsBreak
text:
12 days ago On May 1st, the New York Times reported that as many as 24 million people will lose coverage under the Affordable Care Act due to the expiration of subsidies that Congress did not extend. People simply cannot afford the increased costs. For example: “When Joyce Rena Bumbray-Graves, a 63-year-old home care worker from Woodbridge, Va., saw premiums for her husband and herself more than double, from $544 a month to over $1,300, she had to give up her insurance”.
